card.name: Linking words before vasospasm or serotonin syndrome
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'as', 'include', 'cause' or a comma just before a list of effects in ergot or serotonin syndrome warnings. Also fires on section-number gaps after amphetamine or vasculopathy text.
